options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name.

options.name: options
options.description: { value, label, disabled?, description? } with unique values.

options.name: value
options.description: Selected values in selection order; unknown and duplicate values are dropped.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name: one hidden input per selected value.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Input placeholder while nothing is selected (never replaces the label).

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: At least one value; value-missing after touch or reportValidity().

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the input, toggle, and chip remove buttons.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows the value; the list does not open and chips have no remove buttons.

options.name: invalid
options.description: Consumer-managed invalid state (shown immediately).

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Message shown when invalid is true (text only).

options.name: maxSelected
options.description: Most values that can be selected (integer >= 1); unselected options become unavailable once reached, and reaching it is announced.

options.name: selectAll
options.description: A "Select all" option that toggles every enabled option shown (up to maxSelected).

options.name: filter
options.description: Diacritic- and case-insensitive filtering of options while typing.

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Close the list after each toggle.

options.name: openOnFocus
options.description: Open the list when the input gains focus or is clicked.

options.name: locale
options.description: Messages and filtering locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: Popup alignment.

options.name: renderOption
options.description: Custom option content; the label stays the accessible name. Nodes are released with releaseNode when dropped.

options.name: loadOptions
options.description: Load options for the typed text instead of filtering options; debounced, aborted by a newer query or closing; loading and errors are shown and announced.

options.name: loadDelay
options.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and loadOptions (0 to 5000).

options.name: icons
options.type: Partial<{ expand: IconRef; selected: IconRef; remove: IconRef; error: IconRef }>
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer-provided host (children are owned by the component).

properties.name: value
properties.description: Selected values in selection order (a copy).

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: The value differs from the initial value.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic selection (no aui-change); unknown values are dropped.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove the component, listeners, and released nodes.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { value: string[]; added: string[]; removed: string[] }
events.description: The user changed the selection (option, Select all, chip remove, or Backspace).

events.name: aui-input
events.description: The user edited the input text.

cssClasses.name: aui-multi-select__control
cssClasses.description: The input-like boundary around chips, input, and toggle.

cssClasses.name: aui-multi-select__chip | __chip-label | __remove
cssClasses.description: Selected value chip, its label, and its remove button.

cssClasses.name: aui-multi-select__popup | __listbox | __option | __option--active | __option--all | __check
cssClasses.description: Top-layer popup, listbox, options, active option, Select all, and selection mark.
